description: Buy an active prepared artifact from a wallet-enrolled merchant with standard x402: the first call returns payment requirements; sign locally and retry the same arguments with _meta['x402/payment']. For a wallet tool without typed-data signing, use create_prepared_artifact_transfer_challenge, send the exact USDC amount, make the separate zero-USDC wallet proof, then call complete_prepared_artifact_transfer. Reuse the same identifiers and payment proof after timeouts. Successful delivery includes exact delivery.bodyBase64 bytes and private delivery.artifactProof for commitment verification.
name: buy_prepared_artifact
